notes: Stage (silver) layer lands ALL source columns as String, 1:1 name mapping, no renames or casts.
Type casting to Int/Decimal/Date occurs at the standard (gold) layer only.
Every stage table adds 4 audit columns: LOB, SRC_FILE_NAME (string), REC_CREATION_TIME, REC_UPDATED_TIME (timestamp).
Source dtype casing normalized (e.g. 'string' -> 'String'); NULL Check normalized to boolean 'nullable'.
